exercises.title: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 senses
steps: Look around and name five things you can see.
Notice four things you can feel, like your clothes or chair.
Listen for three sounds, near or far.
Notice two smells. If none are around, skip this step.
Notice one taste, or imagine a familiar flavour.

exercises.title: Feel the support beneath you
steps: Sit comfortably. Rest your feet on the floor, if that suits you.
Gently press down and notice the contact. You can use your hands on a chair instead.
Release the pressure. Notice where the chair or floor supports you. Repeat twice.

exercises.title: Explore one object
steps: Pick up a safe everyday object, like a key or a sleeve.
Notice its weight, temperature and texture. Looking closely is fine too.
Describe three small details to yourself, slowly.

exercises.title: Find a colour around you
steps: Choose a colour and look around where you are.
Find three things in that colour. Name each one slowly.
Choose another colour and repeat. Notice a small detail in each object.

exercises.title: Tune in to nearby sounds
steps: Pause and listen for one sound close to you.
Notice a sound further away. Is it steady, soft or changing?
Move your attention between the sounds a few times. If it's quiet, gently rub your hands and listen.
